schema.name: documents
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE documents(kind TEXT,id TEXT,case_id TEXT,length INTEGER,metadata TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(kind,id))

schema.name: postings
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE postings(kind TEXT,term TEXT,id TEXT,tf INTEGER,PRIMARY KEY(kind,term,id))

schema.name: schedule
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE schedule(ordinal INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,passage_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,batch INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: stats
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE stats(kind TEXT PRIMARY KEY,n INTEGER,avg REAL,k1 REAL,b REAL)

schema.name: terms
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE terms(kind TEXT,term TEXT,df INTEGER,PRIMARY KEY(kind,term))

A_postings_join_documents: SEARCH p USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_postings_1 (kind=? AND term=?)
SEARCH d USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_documents_1 (kind=? AND id=?)
BC_postings_no_join: SEARCH postings USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_postings_1 (kind=? AND term=?)
terms_df_lookup: SEARCH terms USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_terms_1 (kind=? AND term=?)
get_many_256: SEARCH documents USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_documents_1 (kind=? AND id=?)

A.description: Current PersistentBM25.search implementation (postings JOIN documents per term, no preload, default SQLite PRAGMAs).

B.description: Preload (id -> length) and (id -> interned case_id) in memory; query postings without JOIN documents; default SQLite PRAGMAs.

C.description: Variant B + explicit read-only SQLite PRAGMAs (mmap_size=4GiB, cache_size=512MiB, temp_store=MEMORY).
